about: Open (or key-gated) national radar volume archives outside the US and the OPERA feed. Each entry says where one site's volume for one time is and how it is wrapped; rw_odim chooses the decoder from the file's own bytes. Read by gpuwm/obs/radar_archives.py. Probed 2026-10-16.

jma-nict.network: JMA operational radars (Japan), NICT public mirror
jma-nict.site_ids: JMA station id (AKIT, MURO, ...) or number (47582 / RS47582); `rw_odim stations --file <tar>` lists them
jma-nict.licence: provenance open question (JMA data mirrored by NICT); fetched on demand, never redistributed in fixtures
jma-nict.notes: One tar per 10 minutes holds all 20 stations: N5 reflectivity, N6 radial velocity. The archive has whole-day gaps (e.g. 2024-08-27..31 are empty); a missing time is a 404 and is reported as such.

bom-nci.network: Bureau of Meteorology radars (Australia), NCI rq0 level_1 archive
bom-nci.site_ids: NCI rq0 numeric site id (2 = Melbourne, 54 = Sydney Kurnell, ...); https://thredds.nci.org.au/thredds/fileServer/rq0/radar_site_list.csv
bom-nci.latency_note: NCI ingests one to three days behind real time; the newest day zip on 2026-10-16 was 2026-10-15
bom-nci.notes: A site-day zip is about 1 GB; only its central directory and the one member are read, by HTTP range requests.

ideam-s3.site_ids: IDEAM site folder: Barrancabermeja, Bogota, Carimagua, Corozal, Munchique, Tablazo, santa_elena
ideam-s3.notes: IRIS RAW for most sites (one file per task: e.g. Tablazo's RAWYSAT surveillance and RAWYSBR Doppler volume start together and are fetched together); CfRadial 1 (.nc / .nc.gz) for Bogota and santa_elena. Batches land 4-12 h late.

kma-apihub.network: KMA radars (South Korea), API Hub raw volumes

auth.how: create a free account at https://apihub.kma.go.kr, apply for the radar raw-data API (rdr_file_down.php, rdr=UF) on the radar data page, and put the issued authKey in this variable. Without it the API answers HTTP 401 ('not a valid auth key'), measured 2026-10-16.

kma-apihub.site_ids: KMA three-letter radar code (KWK, BRI, GDK, ...)
kma-apihub.notes: UF raw volumes; qcd=0 raw, qcd=1 quality-controlled.
